agreements: Both reviews correctly identify the cloned-state identical-pool design as the decisive identification feature, with provider stochasticity confined to pool creation and not the cross-arm contrast.
Both reviews agree the mandatory controls (duplicated-winner, random-nonwinner, precommitted rollout-0, SkillCAT-style contrast, winner-only) are sufficient for the narrow E0 pilot authorization.
Both reviews correctly note that n=12 is adequate only for the E1 decision rule, not for a paper-level claim, and the contract explicitly says so.
Both reviews agree the public-dataset roles are non-shopping and correctly gated behind controlled-suite mechanism success.
Both reviews agree the scientific object is appropriately narrow and the closest-work reduction boundary is honest.
disagreements: The other review's suggestion to predeclare how partial updater acceptance or empty edits will be counted is a reasonable E1 receipt improvement, but it is not blocking for E0 pilot authorization because E0 is a pool-law and rescue-support qualification, not an updater experiment.

The other review's request to report all pairwise control contrasts in E1 is good practice, but the contract already lists the controls (RW-DUP, RW-random-nonwinner, SkillCAT-style-WIN, PRE-WIN, Delta versus rescue count) in the statistics section, so this is partially addressed.
exact_preexecution_conditions: Run only the 12-task E0 pilot from the frozen manifest; no task replacement for any model outcome.
Stop the tranche on any resolved model identity change from deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813.
E0 pilot stop condition: zero rescue events or protocol failure; otherwise predeclared extension allowed.
E1 remains conditional on E0 support (at least 6 rescue tasks and >=3 families) and integrity; no E1 authorization is granted by this review.
No paper claims, benchmark claims, or front-end claims are authorized; paper_claim_authority is false.
issues_resolved_by_existing_controls: Token/context-length effects are controlled by duplicated-winner.
Generic diversity effects are controlled by random-nonwinner.
Alternative fixed observation kernels are controlled by precommitted rollout-0.
Strongest direct method reduction is controlled by SkillCAT-style contrast.
Provider stochasticity is addressed by freezing resolved model identity, temperature 0, retry 0, and tranche stop on resolved-id change.
Pseudoreplication is avoided by using the independently evolved eight-task stream-state as the scientific unit.
review.single_sentence_verdict: The exact F0-R4 contract is identifiable, falsifiable, and control-complete for the narrow 12-task E0 pilot, with both independent reviews converging on GO and no blocking issue surviving cross-examination.
